title: IntelliFlow Autonomous Delivery Task Contract
description: Machine-readable contract governing a single autonomous task dispatch. Every dispatch MUST produce a valid instance of this schema before execution begins. Defined by ADR-070.

taskId.description: Unique task identifier matching the Sprint_plan.csv Task ID column, e.g. 'ORCH-002' or 'ORCH-002-task-contract-schema-and-dispatch-guard'.

approvedOutcome.description: Human-readable statement of what this task delivers, verbatim from the supervisor lease directive. Not a summary — must faithfully reproduce the approved outcome scope.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Acceptance criteria for this task. May be a single string (semicolon-delimited) or an ordered array. Each criterion must be independently verifiable.

baselineMainSha.description: The full or abbreviated SHA of origin/main at the time of dispatch. Used for freshness checks: the worktree must be based on this SHA.

specHash.description: SHA-256 (or abbreviated) hash of the spec file at dispatch time. Guards against spec drift between contract authoring and execution.

policyVersion.description: Identifies which policy revision governs this dispatch, e.g. 'ADR-069-v1' or 'ADR-070-v1'. Must reference an existing ADR.

dependencySnapshot.description: Reference to the dependency snapshot valid at dispatch time, e.g. a lockfile hash ('pnpm-lock.yaml@sha256:abc123') or 'baseline-1810a937' for the full package state.

riskClass.description: Risk classification per ADR-069. Low = new files, no migrations. Medium = existing file edits, no DB. High = DB migrations, shared infra. Critical = production data mutations.

priority.description: Dispatch priority determining queue position when multiple tasks compete for an agent slot.

estimatedEffort.description: Human-readable effort estimate in O/M/P format (e.g. '4/8/16') or a single value (e.g. '4h'). Optimistic / Most-likely / Pessimistic in hours.

timeBudget.description: Maximum wall-clock time before the lease expires and the supervisor is notified. Format: integer followed by 'm' (minutes), 'h' (hours), or 'd' (days). Example: '2h'.

retryBudget.description: Maximum number of retries permitted on gate failure before the task is escalated to a human. 0 = no retries (fail → escalate immediately).

validationProfile.description: Required validation gates before merge. Examples: 'full-preship' (all 12 required CI contexts), 'scoped-unit-tests-only' (lane-constrained), or an explicit list of gate names.

expectedArtifacts.description: Ordered list of repo-relative paths of expected output artifacts. The validator and post-execution checks confirm these exist before attesting completion.

branch.description: Git branch name for this task. Must match the branch the executing agent has checked out in the worktree. Part of the 4-way dispatch binding.

worktree.description: Absolute filesystem path of the isolated worktree for this task. Must match the agent's actual working directory. Part of the 4-way dispatch binding.

agentLeaseId.description: Unique identifier for this dispatch instance. Format: '<sessionId>' or '<sessionId>-<taskId>' (e.g. 'local_28109fae'). MUST be unique across all active leases. Part of the 4-way dispatch binding.

leaseExpiry.description: ISO 8601 datetime (UTC) when this lease expires. On expiry, the supervisor is notified and the task may be re-dispatched or escalated.

allowedMutationScope.description: Glob patterns or explicit repo-relative paths defining the allowed mutation boundary for this task. Mutations outside this scope are a contract violation. Example: ['.specify/**', 'tools/scripts/orchestration/**', 'docs/architecture/adr/ADR-070*.md'].

humanEscalationConditions.description: Conditions under which the agent MUST stop and hand off to a human. May be a prose string or an ordered list. At minimum must include 'any Category C decision' and 'any gate failure exceeding retryBudget'.
